title: Photon statistics in waveguide QED: II Exact solutions in a thermodynamic limit
summary: Waveguide quantum electrodynamics (WQED) offers a powerful framework for controlling light-matter interactions and realizing collective phenomena such as super- and subradiance. In general waveguide settings, the quantum dynamics spans the full Hilbert space, rendering exact theoretical treatments exponentially difficult and currently out of reach, and only a few models have exact, analytical solutions.
